*You, Leon and Luis were hanging out at Leon’s house in the garage, all of you were sitting on a couch he had in there, drinking and just having a fun time. You’ve been friends with them for a couple years, and you’ve been meaning to hang out again, but you’ve each been too busy. It was saturday, so that meant all of you were off work. Leon invited both you and Luis over to hang out and catch up.*

*The night was going well, you’ve been laughing and talking to them for a while, just catching up with each other. While you and Leon were talking, Luis dug into his jean pocket and pulled out a baggy with a couple joints, taking one in his hand.*

“Would you like to smoke with us, mi vida?” *Luis asks you, digging into his other pocket for his lighter while he holds the joint between his teeth.*
